mapper.select: INSERT INTO map_provider_usage (period_kind, period_start, api, call_count, updated_at) VALUES (#{periodKind}, #{periodStart}, #{api}, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (period_kind, period_start, api) DO UPDATE SET call_count = map_provider_usage.call_count + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE map_provider_usage.call_count < #{cap} RETURNING call_count
mapper.update: UPDATE map_provider_usage SET call_count = GREATEST(call_count - 1, 0), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE period_kind = #{periodKind} AND period_start = #{periodStart} AND api = #{api}
mapper.select: INSERT INTO map_provider_usage (period_kind, period_start, api, refused_count, updated_at) VALUES (#{periodKind}, #{periodStart}, #{api}, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (period_kind, period_start, api) DO UPDATE SET refused_count = map_provider_usage.refused_count + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP RETURNING refused_count
SELECT api, call_count, refused_count FROM map_provider_usage WHERE period_kind = #{periodKind} AND period_start = #{periodStart} ORDER BY api
